result.markdown: --- title: "[Ptype]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} A structural snapshot of the training data used for boundary checks. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/blob/examples-section/shoez/ptype.py#L60-L159){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python Ptype(schema, roles, transform_required) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Captured at ``Recipe.fit()`` and exposed as ``FittedRecipe.ptype``. Holds the training :class:`narwhals.Schema` (column names and dtypes), the role assignments, and a precomputed per-column flag for whether each column is required at ``transform()`` time. ::: ## Attributes {.doc-attributes} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [schema]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [nw.Schema]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The training frame's narwhals schema: an ordered name→dtype mapping. [roles]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Roles]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Role assignments captured at fit (see ``design/roles.md``). [transform_required]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[str, bool]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Per-column flag: ``True`` if the column must be present in new data at ``transform()`` time. Computed once at fit from role requirements and any ``update_role_requirements`` overrides. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} The ptype is built by the recipe; read it back from a fitted recipe: ::: {#ec78e115 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd from shoez import Recipe, StepNormalize from shoez import Selectors as s df = pd.DataFrame({"x": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0], "y": [0, 1, 0]}) rec = Recipe(outcome="y", predictors="x").add( StepNormalize(s.numeric_predictors()) ) rec = rec.fit(df) rec.ptype.schema.names() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ['x', 'y'] ``` ::: :::
